title: Delayed cooperative two-member owner ACP ticket exchange (draft)
description: On the original authenticated H/R admission session, R requests cooperative.owner-acp-ticket.v3 only after independently verifying both 21-field member attach results against the same A-signed aggregate Ready. H issues one ticket only after rechecking the same live R kernel identity, both attached member selectors and launch IDs under that Ready, and trusted B readiness evidence for both exact A-observed children and arm receipts. The result binds the primary R reservation/start/launch and Ready envelope hash; it is not A authority. A fresh cooperative.acp.v3 owner stream spends the 32-byte ticket once. No ticket or ACP bytes before all joins; refusal has no state transition.

acp_ticket_base64url.description: Canonical unpadded base64url of exactly 32 fresh one-use H ticket bytes; verifier checks decode and re-encode equality.
